decisions.reason: The candidate's existing same-message INTRODUCE already captures the authoritative revised manuscript and yellow-highlighted additions. The two new requests concern editorial wording and voice, not a change to which client revisions must be integrated.
The sentence and passage editing requests do not change the requirement to advise the client about publishing the book as a paperback.
The requested grammar and narrative-voice revisions do not affect whether AI-generated images are suitable as chapter illustrations.
